local_committed_vfs.cloudflare_boundary: command -> native FUSE -> release -> SHA-256/512-KiB chunks -> process-local SQLite transaction
local_committed_vfs.layerfs_boundary: command -> native FUSE -> explicit whole-workspace checkpoint -> accepted Store COMMIT
local_committed_vfs.qualification: LayerFS survives daemon/container restart; Cloudflare's published local SQLiteTestStorage is process-lifetime :memory: state.

restart_durable_full_product.cloudflare_required_boundary: command -> local SQLite -> post-exec pullOnce -> missing-object transfer -> Durable Object SQLite apply -> acknowledged result -> container restart
restart_durable_full_product.layerfs_boundary: command -> accepted checkpoint -> Store reopen verification
restart_durable_full_product.reason: The existing Docker baseline omitted UPSTREAM_URL/post-exec pull; local pull scripts receive into another in-memory SQLiteTestStorage; wrangler dev lacks native FUSE and uses x64 emulation on this ARM64 host.

published_baseline_excludes: post-exec pull to authoritative Durable Object

durable_threshold_policy.reason: The published ratios and gates compare local/transient boundaries, not full-product restart durability.

required_external_authority: R2 binding permission or a frozen benchmark deployment without that optional mount
